cartographic_interpretation.temporal_interpretation: 1954 was printed for original edition; 1961 modifies communication lines only. Neither proves complete 1961 revision or municipal limits as of 1963.
cartographic_interpretation.legend_interpretation: The inspected LIMITES panel has international and interstate boundary symbols and a frontier marker, with no municipal-boundary legend class. This concerns the printed symbol key, not proof of absence of every line anywhere on the map.
